title: Fleet orchestrator TUI
brief: Terminal UI (180×50 cells, Gentle Shell theme palettes) for `gentle-shell orchestrator`: the human chats with one fleet orchestrator that leads up to three headless Gentle Shell members, and sees in a friendly, customizable way how each member unfolds, what it is thinking, and which questions wait on them, without the office metaphor.

artboards.title: Command deck
artboards.tradeoff: Familiar and dense: chat plus a rail of member cards with a pinned question inbox; each member's thinking is compressed to one line

artboards.title: Transit map
artboards.tradeoff: Best at-a-glance progress and doubles as the fleet odd.md view; needs width and shows less per-member detail

artboards.title: One conversation
artboards.tradeoff: Simplest mental model, one timeline with member cards inline; can get noisy and relies on filters and collapsing

artboards.title: Focus lens
artboards.tradeoff: Least distraction with the deepest view of one member's reasoning, todos and tools; seeing the others takes a keypress
